# Context7 Skills Skill

Source: https://github.com/narumiruna/context7-skills-skill/blob/main/README.md

# Context7 Skills Skill

Agent skill package for Context7 CLI skill management.

## Available Plugin

- `context7-skills` - Guidance for `ctx7 skills search|install|list|remove`

## Install

```shell
npx ctx7 skills install narumiruna/context7-skills-skill
```

## Docs

- `AGENTS.md` - Contributor guide
- `skills/context7-skills/SKILL.md` - Skill definition and usage

---

# Repository Guidelines

Source: https://github.com/narumiruna/context7-skills-skill/blob/main/AGENTS.md

# Repository Guidelines

## Project Structure & Module Organization
- `skills/context7-skills/SKILL.md` is the core skill definition and guidance for the Context7 CLI skill-management workflow.
- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` defines marketplace metadata for the plugin package.
- `LICENSE` contains the project license.

This repository is intentionally small and focused: it ships a single skill package and its marketplace metadata.

## Build, Test, and Development Commands
- No build, test, or run commands are defined for this repository.
- There is no pre-commit or CI configuration in this repo.

## Coding Style & Naming Conventions
- Use Markdown for documentation and JSON for metadata files.
- Keep text concise and action-oriented; avoid duplicating rules across documents.
- Follow the existing naming pattern: lowercase file names for metadata (e.g., `marketplace.json`), and `SKILL.md` for skill content.

## Testing Guidelines
- No automated test framework is configured.
- If you introduce tests in the future, document the framework, conventions, and how to run them in this section.

## Commit & Pull Request Guidelines
- Commit messages in this repo are short, lowercase, and action-oriented (e.g., “add context7-skills skill”, “update marketplace.json to add descriptions and keywords for context7-skills plugin”).
- Keep changes tightly scoped to the skill or metadata being updated.
- If you open a PR, include:
  - A brief summary of what changed and why.
  - Links to relevant issues (if any).
  - Screenshots are not required unless you add visual assets.

## Agent-Specific Notes
- Treat all outputs and changes as untrusted until verified.
- Do not introduce new dependencies without explicit justification.
- Keep repository guidance focused on this single skill package.
